'''Research Centers''' were military facilities used to research new technology, mainly in regards to improved targeting, defense or production efficiency throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. They were produced by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or organic workers such as [[Glurrg]]s or [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] at a cost of 210 units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] all used their own version of Research Centers.

==Behind the scenes==
Research Centers appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].
